source_text: Adaptive signal timing reduced mean queue length in the simulated corridor [CIT_SYN_01]. A separate experiment found that packet loss increased when roadside-unit density was reduced [CIT_SYN_02]. These findings concern different subsystems and should not be treated as evidence for the same mechanism.

gold_assertions.proposition: adaptive signal timing reduced mean queue length in simulated corridor
gold_assertions.evidence: Adaptive signal timing reduced mean queue length in the simulated corridor [CIT_SYN_01].

gold_assertions.proposition: reduced roadside-unit density was associated with increased packet loss in the separate experiment
gold_assertions.evidence: A separate experiment found that packet loss increased when roadside-unit density was reduced [CIT_SYN_02].

gold_assertions.proposition: the two findings concern different subsystems and are not evidence for the same mechanism
gold_assertions.evidence: These findings concern different subsystems and should not be treated as evidence for the same mechanism.

source_text: Among vehicles observed during the evening window, higher beacon density was associated with shorter discovery time. The result may reflect improved neighbor awareness, but the experiment does not establish that beacon density causes the reduction. The finding was not evaluated outside the evening window.

source_text: The controller first discards readings older than 60 s. It then normalizes valid sensor values using parameters fixed before evaluation. Vehicles with missing position data are excluded from route optimization. The optimizer runs for 200 iterations with seed 17, after which the selected route is stored without further tuning.

source_text: The scheduler calculates the priority value P_i = w_1U_i + w_2D_i for every task i. U_i is utilization and D_i is normalized deadline pressure. The weights w_1 and w_2 are fixed before the run. A task obtains a larger priority only when the weighted combination becomes larger; the equation itself is not changed during adaptation.

source_text: The evaluation includes three traffic densities. Reliability is measured as delivery ratio. Delay is also measured. The controller uses the same parameter values in all densities. The purpose of keeping the parameters fixed is to determine whether performance changes arise under different loads rather than from retuning the controller.
